examples.name: Default
examples.summary: One date in a field: the trigger shows the picked day, the panel holds the month grid, a typed date field and Apply.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DatePickerRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/date-picker-root'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DatePickerRoot
    v-model="date"
    aria-label="Start date"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Sizes
Horizontal
examples.summary: `orientation="horizontal"` places the date and time fields and Apply beside the month grid, with a full-height divider.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DatePickerRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/date-picker-root'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DatePickerRoot
    v-model="date"
    orientation="horizontal"
    clearable
    show-time
  />
</template>
